description: List the website's stored AI insights: the precomputed cards on the AI Insights page, each a verified finding of one past analysis, newest analysis first and higher impact first. Each has its id, title, headline, category, impact, the days its numbers cover (window), the time the analysis ran (analyzed_at), its status (available, done, or discarded = hidden by the team), the team's rating, and its move's subject and metric. Call this first for an open-ended request for insights or for what to do ('give me some insights', 'what's interesting', 'what should I prioritize'), and answer from these cards instead of running a new analysis: highest impact first, each by its title and headline. Always state the window and the date the analysis ran, and offer a fresh look with the other analytics tools. Read one card in full with get_ai_insight. Paged: 20 by default; for more, pass limit (up to 50) and offset set to the returned next_offset until it is null. Default status is available. Returns status 'no_access' when AI Insights is not part of the organization's setup. Then, or when no insight is listed, answer from the other analytics tools.

offset.description: How many to skip: the previous read's next_offset.

status.description: The lifecycle to list: available (default), done, or discarded (hidden by the team).

name: get_ai_insights
